claim: *Realization Over Time.* Weekly commits landing on main across the project's 29 weeks, split by reconstructed authorship provenance, with dotted build-stage boundaries. The late-era shift from agent-attributed commits to merge-train squashes records a change in landing mechanism, not a slowdown: one squash stands for many underlying agent commits, so the total series is the cross-regime-comparable trace.
topology: Quantitative axes preserve source values and categories.
bw_encoding: Explicit labels, distinct markers and monochrome patterns; no color-only distinction.
redesign: Dotted stage boundaries retained; provenance encoded by solid, hatch, and white bars. Restored external units and interpretive annotations at 10 pt.
